publicComments.name: Julio Seguite
publicComments.summary: Spoke in Spanish expressing deep gratitude for the board and Connect school's impact on his family, noting that his child succeeded at Connect and urging the board to trust the teachers and continue supporting the community.

publicComments.name: Amanda Vaughn
publicComments.summary: Spoke as Connect's art and newcomer teacher, praising the school's SEL approach, newcomer support program, and the tremendous growth she has witnessed in students over her three years at the school.

publicComments.name: Mayda Ocalo
publicComments.summary: Spoke as a long-term substitute/guest teacher at Connect, explaining why she proposed a contract arrangement with the school and urging the district to renew the charter given the school's transformative impact on students.

publicComments.name: Anton (Monique Pusales card — Anton spoke)
publicComments.summary: Spoke as Connect's music teacher, describing the school's enrichment programs and the student musical production 'Space Is the Place' as a flagship project-based learning accomplishment involving nearly every student.

publicComments.name: Walter Soto Franco
publicComments.summary: Spoke as a recent Connect graduate originally from Guatemala, sharing how the school helped him learn English and build confidence, and expressing hope that his own future children could attend Connect.

publicComments.name: Ixamar Giron
publicComments.summary: Spoke as a Connect Class of 2020 alumna now studying mechanical engineering at San Francisco State University, describing the lasting positive impact Connect had on her and her siblings.

publicComments.name: Ashley Solis
publicComments.summary: Spoke as a current 8th grader who has attended Connect since 3rd grade, thanking the school for helping her learn English and for the caring treatment from staff.
